izzyondroid:com.steel101.wearsyncforbree.description:
major update added radar to phone and watch app.
 Wear Sync for Breezy A lightweight bridge application that syncs detailed weather data from the Breezy Weather Android app to your Wear OS watch.
 What it does Breezy Weather is a fantastic open-source weather app, but it doesn't always have a native way to send its rich data to every Wear OS watch face or tile. This app acts as a "sync bridge":
 It reads weather data directly from Breezy Weather's internal database (using a secure Content Provider).
 It processes current conditions, detailed metrics (UV, Humidity, Wind, etc.), and forecasts.
 It pushes that data to your connected Wear OS device instantly.
 Key Features * Detailed Metrics: Syncs more than just temperature: * Current Temp & "Feels Like" * Humidity, Pressure, UV Index, and Visibility * Wind Speed and Direction * Air Quality Index (AQI) and Dew Point * Precipitation Probability (Rain Chance) * Forecasts: * 7-Day daily forecast (Highs/Lows/Icons). * 6-Hour hourly forecast. * Unit Support: Automatically detects and respects your preference for Celsius or Fahrenheit.
 Installation & Setup
 Breezy Weather: Ensure you have Breezy Weather installed and configured on your phone.
 Permissions: When you first open this sync app, tap "Fetch & Sync". It will request permission to read data from Breezy Weather.
 Watch App: Ensure the companion app is installed on your Wear OS watch to receive and display the data.
 Optimization: For reliable background syncing, it is recommended to disable "Battery Optimization" for this app so Android doesn't kill the background sync service.
 How it works
 The Phone App: Displays a preview of the data being synced and the "Last Synced" timestamp so you know your watch is up to date.
 The Service: Runs a START_STICKY background service that listens for system changes and handles the communication with Google Play Services Wearable API.
 Data Privacy: This app does not have internet access. It only reads data locally from one app on your phone and sends it locally to your own watch.
 Disclaimer: This is an independent companion app and is not officially affiliated with the main Breezy Weather development team.

fdroid:app.zornslemma.dayfile.description:
Dayfile helps you make notes about your daily life. It works entirely offline, so your notes stay on your device, and it's your responsibility to back them up so you don't lose them if something happens to your phone.
 The idea is that making a note should be as low-friction as possible. Open the app, type, close or background it. The note is automatically attached to the current date. You can optionally have predefined categories to help split up the day's notes, but that's it: entries are free text with no attempt at imposing a structure beyond the categories.
 There are no reminders or alarms, and no formal support for time tracking more precise than “a day”.
 This is almost embarrassingly primitive, which is the whole point. You can use a text editor to make notes, but then you have to worry about having the right file open and entering the date correctly. A calendar app is organised around appointments and arbitrary dates; a journalling app may be more heavyweight than you want.
 The emphasis here is simply on making a quick note with minimal ceremony. The less effort it is to make the note, the more likely it is that you'll actually make it.

* No advertising, no analytics, no trackers, no third-party services.
* Your data lives only on your device and in the Nextcloud you control — never
 in any developer or third-party cloud.
* HTTPS only. The Nextcloud app password is stored in the operating system's
 secure storage and can be revoked at any time.
Cairn is an aggregator and viewer, not a medical device. It makes no diagnostic
or treatment claims.

This multilingual dictionary contains the Galnet lexical database (http://sli.uvigo.gal/galnet/) which is being developed by the Computational Linguistics Group at the University of Vigo (http://sli.uvigo.gal) and is available from 2011.
The goal of the Galnet development is integrating the Galician language into the interlingual lexical-semantic network of WordNet (https://wordnet.princeton.edu), according the EuroWordNet model. Galnet is part of the Multilingual Central Repository (http://adimen.si.ehu.es/web/MCR) and the Open Multilingual Wordnet (http://compling.hss.ntu.edu.sg/iliomw/omw). Galnet contents can be searched with several web applications and can also be downloaded in RDF and LMF formats with a free license (http://sli.uvigo.gal/download/SLI_Galnet/).

The term dB HL describes your hearing loss in decibels.
The table below shows a common way to classify hearing loss
(Source: Clark, J. G. (1981). Uses and abuses of hearing loss classification. Asha, 23, 493–500.)
Degree of hearing loss: dB HL range
Normal: –10 to 15
Slight: 16 to 25
Mild: 26 to 40
Moderate: 41 to 55
Moderately severe: 56 to 70
Severe: 71 to 90
Profound: 91+
First your earphones must be calibrated. You can either perform a full test which requires one or better several persons between the ages of 18 and 35 with normal hearing. Or you can perform a simple calibration at 1000Hz only (assuming good hearing at this frequency). In this case it is assumed that the earphones are linear across the frequency range and calibration values for the other frequencies are then calculated using the ISO226:2003 standard. Whenever you hear a beep simply touch the screen. You can pause / continue with a long click and speed up with a double click. If you have several persons available for calibration simply press "Add Calibration" and an average value of existing calibrations will be calculated. You may also delete the whole calibration.
After that you can perform tests and view them in test results.
You can then also perform tests at single frequencies. There you can manually select ear, frequency, and sound amplitude by clicking on the buttons.

PostMimic — AI social that sounds like you
Stop posting generic AI sludge. PostMimic learns your voice — vocabulary, humor, sentence rhythm, perspective — from your real posting history (and optional .docx/.txt writing). Then it drafts, schedules, and publishes in your voice across X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.
Free to download. 5 free AI-generated posts so you can hear yourself come through. Continued generation and the features below need an auto-renewable subscription (Starter or Pro). Plans and pricing at the bottom.
Works on iPhone Duo
Works folded or unfolded. Opened Duo gets a 6-tab rail and two-column More — same app, not a dual-screen gimmick. Made for iPhone Duo badge is already on the store.
Generate that matches your ask
Say “good news” (or any tone) and the draft stays in that lane — outrage stories don’t sneak in. Turn on include-links and the source URL actually attaches to the post.
Drafts you can see and fix
See the link and whether it’s in the post or a reply. Remove or replace video without fighting the draft. Post Doctor (apply / sources / queue review) helps you tighten what you’re about to ship.
Your voice, more ways
Train from platform archives or upload your own .docx/.txt writing — not only scraped history.
One place for your accounts
Create once, publish formatted for each platform’s tone and length. Cloud scheduling and drip campaigns when you want them. Manage multiple voice profiles on Pro (agencies / multi-client). Brand safety controls on Pro for regulated work and agencies.
Native iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web
Same engine everywhere. Google sign-in once. Generate stays reliable after voice training.
How it works
1. Connect accounts or upload your writing.
2. PostMimic learns your voice.
3. Generate, review, schedule — or leave a schedule running.
Plans and pricing
- Free: 5 AI posts total to try
- Starter Monthly: $19.99/month — 200 cloud AI posts/month, 1 profile, cloud scheduling, basic analytics
- Starter Annual: $189.99/year (~$15.83/month)
- Pro Monthly: $39.99/month — 500 cloud AI posts/month, 5 profiles, brand rules, full analytics

A 3-day free trial is offered for new subscribers on each plan. After the trial, your plan auto-renews at the price above unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID subscription settings.
Start free with 5 AI posts. Upgrade anytime. Cancel anytime.
PostMimic is built by Vibe Labs Digital, a San Antonio-based social media agency.

apple-macos:6769753335.name: Streamly: IPTV Smart Player
apple-macos:6769753335.description:
Streamly is a clean, fast player for the IPTV playlists you already have — native on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. Paste your M3U URL or Xtream Codes credentials and Streamly turns the raw playlist into a real interface: channel grid, movie and series posters, live preview, search, favorites, and Picture-in-Picture.
You bring the IPTV. Streamly brings the player.
HYBRID PLAYBACK ENGINE
Streamly pairs Apple's native AVPlayer with a built-in VLC engine. AVPlayer handles standard streams (HLS, MP4, MKV); VLC takes over for exotic codecs and malformed playlists, with automatic fallback — so you stop seeing "format not supported."
NATIVE ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE
- iPhone — one-handed playback, Picture-in-Picture, voice search, offline downloads
- iPad — multi-column layout with Split View
- Mac — a real macOS app with sidebar and menu bar
- Apple TV — full-screen poster art, focus-engine navigation, Siri Remote voice search
One purchase covers them all — Streamly Pro uses Apple's Universal Purchase, so subscribing on one device unlocks Pro everywhere.
FEATURES
- M3U and Xtream Codes playlists
- Live channel grid with EPG (when your provider supplies one)
- Movies and series with posters, plot, year, and genre — optionally enriched from the open TMDB catalog
- Continue Watching and personalized rails across your signed-in devices
- Voice search via on-device speech recognition
- Picture-in-Picture and background audio
- AirPlay, Google Cast, and DLNA
- Light, Dark, and Auto themes
- Works fully anonymously; Sign in with Apple or Google is optional
STREAMLY PRO
Free includes 1 custom playlist plus 1 Quick Add list, 5 favorites, and 1 manual refresh per day. Upgrade to Pro for:
- Unlimited playlists, favorites, and refreshes
- Auto-refresh on a schedule (1h, 6h, 12h, 24h)
- Offline downloads for movies and episodes
- PIN-lock playlists (parental control)
- Live channel auto-play and auto-play-next
- Multi-device live sync of playlists, favorites, and history (free: playlist backup only)
PRICING
- Streamly Pro Monthly — $4.99
- Streamly Pro Annual — $19.99 with a 7-day free trial
- Streamly Pro Lifetime — $59.99 one-time, every Apple device under your Apple ID
Subscriptions auto-renew until cancelled; manage anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
PRIVACY
No ads, no third-party trackers, no data sold. Your provider credentials stay in the device Keychain, encrypted by the OS. Streamly uses Firebase for crash reporting and anonymous analytics, and RevenueCat for subscriptions — both documented in the Privacy Policy.
ABOUT IPTV
Streamly is a player — comparable to VLC or a web browser. It does not host, distribute, sell, or recommend any video content. Every stream you load is one you supply, from a source you have a legal right to access. If you don't have a provider, the Quick Add rail offers a few free public-broadcast playlists (NASA TV, France 24, DW News, Al Jazeera English, and more) from the open iptv-org catalog.
SUPPORT
Support & FAQ: https://streamly-app.github.io/support.html
Privacy Policy: https://streamly-app.github.io/privacy.html

flathub:org.musicbrainz.Picard.name: MusicBrainz Picard
flathub:org.musicbrainz.Picard.summary: Picard is a cross-platform music tagger powered by the MusicBrainz database
flathub:org.musicbrainz.Picard.description:
Do you need to clean up your music library? Picard is an open-source cross-platform music tagger
 by MusicBrainz. It has the ability to identify audio files even without any existing metadata.
 Picard helps you organize your music collection by renaming your music files and sorting them
 into a folder structure exactly the way you want it. A variety of plugins are available and you
 can even write your own. Picard supports a wide range of audio formats and can also lookup an entire
 CD for you.
 Tagging audio files has never been easier.
 Features:
 Multiple formats: Picard supports all popular music formats, including MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A,
 WMA, WAV, and more.
 AcoustID: Picard uses AcoustID audio fingerprints, allowing files to be identified by the
 actual music, even if they have no metadata.
 Comprehensive database: Picard uses the open and community-maintained MusicBrainz database
 to provide accurate information about millions of music releases.
 CD lookups: Picard can lookup entire music CDs with a click.
 Plugin support: If you need a particular feature, you can choose from a selection of available
 plugins or write your own.
 Scripting: A flexible but easy to learn scripting language allows you to exactly specify
 how your music files will be named and how the tags will look like.
 Cover Art: Picard can find and download the correct cover art for your albums.
 Open Source: Picard is licensed under the GNU General Public License 2.0 or later, and is
 hosted on GitHub where it is actively developed by some awesome developers.

fedora-packages:libsemigroups/libsemigro.description: Libsemigroups is a C++ library for semigroups and monoids; it is partly based on "Algorithms for computing finite semigroups", "Expository Slides", and Semigroupe 2.01 by Jean-Eric Pin. The libsemigroups library is used in the Semigroups package for GAP. Some of the features of Semigroupe 2.01 are not yet implemented in libsemigroups; this is a work in progress. Missing features include those for: - Green's relations, or classes - finding a zero - minimal ideal, principal left/right ideals, or indeed any ideals - inverses - local submonoids - the kernel - variety tests. These will be included in a future version. Libsemigroups performs roughly the same as Semigroupe 2.01 when there is a known upper bound on the size of the semigroup being enumerated, and this is used to initialize the data structures for the semigroup; see libsemigroups::Semigroup::reserve for more details. Note that in Semigroupe 2.01 it is always necessary to provide such an upper bound, but in libsemigroups it is not. Libsemigroups also has some advantages over Semigroupe 2.01: - there is a (hopefully) convenient C++ API, which makes it relatively easy to create and manipulate semigroups and monoids - there are some multithreaded methods for semigroups and their congruences - you do not have to know/guess the size of a semigroup or monoid before you begin - libsemigroups supports more types of elements than Semigroupe 2.01 - it is relatively straightforward to add support for further types of elements and semigroups - it is possible to enumerate a certain number of elements of a semigroup or monoid (say if you are looking for an element with a particular property), to stop, and then to start the enumeration again at a later point - you can instantiate as many semigroups and monoids as you can fit in memory - it is possible to add more generators after a semigroup or monoid has been constructed, without losing or having to recompute any information that was previously known - libsemigroups contains rudimentary implementations of the Todd-Coxeter and Knuth-Bendix algorithms for finitely presented semigroups, which can also be used to compute congruences of a (not necessarily finitely presented) semigroup or monoid.

firefox-addons:2590216.description:

firefox-addons:3055694.name: Moj Ad Blocker
firefox-addons:3055694.summary:
Lightweight ad and tracker blocker for Firefox. Blocks known ad
networks and analytics domains, hides leftover ad containers, and
lets you disable blocking per site. No data leaves your browser.
firefox-addons:3055694.description:
Moj Ad Blocker is a lightweight blocker built around three things:
speed, transparency, and staying out of your way.
What it does
Blocks requests to known ad networks, content recommendation
widgets, and analytics or tracking domains before they load.
Hides leftover ad containers that would otherwise leave empty gaps
on the page.
Counts blocked requests per tab and in total, so you can see what
is actually happening.
Lets you turn blocking off for any individual site with one click.
First-party requests are never blocked, which keeps sites working.
Privacy
Nothing is collected, and nothing is transmitted. All settings are
stored locally in your browser. The extension has no server, no
analytics, and no account.
About the name
In former Yugoslavia, the commercial break on television was called
EPP, short for ekonomsko-propagandni program. The icon is a nod to
that era and to the test card that filled the screen when there was
nothing to broadcast.

firefox-addons:3072848.name: DevelopDashboard Local Bridge
firefox-addons:3072848.summary: Let DevelopDashboard tools reach localhost and custom local hostnames (e.g. develop.test) via your browser.
firefox-addons:3072848.description:
DevelopDashboard Local Bridge lets tools on developdashboard.com talk to websites and APIs running on your computer.
DevelopDashboard is a modular developer dashboard: UUID generators, formatters, HTTP helpers, AI-built custom tools, and more — arranged on your personal board. Sandboxed tools can call public HTTPS APIs through the dashboard’s server proxy. That proxy cannot see localhost on your machine. This extension fills that gap.

firefox-addons:867816.summary: Mainly for looking up dictionaries and automatic translation. Since you can register any site, you can use it for various searches. You can also launch a sub process so you can use local dictionaries or open current page with IE or Google Chrome.
firefox-addons:867816.description:

firefox-addons:2873137.summary: Hides images/videos on websites. One-click to turn off the image display，You can set a whitelist for a website.
firefox-addons:2873137.description:
This extension hides images and videos for less distractions.
This chrome extension to hide all images and videos by default.
Shows images again by clicking the "Add to Whitelist" button.
Extension provides the following functions
1. Turn on the no-image mode with one click, and all websites will hide images and videos.

firefox-addons:2950481.name: AI Video Enhancer | upscaler Video Quality
firefox-addons:2950481.summary: Transform low-quality videos into HD/4K content with AI-powered enhancement, noise reduction, stabilization, and smart upscaling.
firefox-addons:2950481.description:
Enhance and restore your videos with cutting-edge AI technology that intelligently upscales resolution, removes noise, stabilizes shaky footage, and improves overall visual quality - all in your browser. Perfect for content creators, marketers, and anyone looking to breathe new life into old or low-quality videos.
🎯 Key Features
• 📈 Multi-Resolution Upscaling
Choose from three quality tiers: 720p (HD Quality), 1080p (Full HD), or 4K (Ultra HD) to match your exact needs.
• 🎞️ Frame Rate Control
Adjust the output frame rate with an intuitive slider to optimize smoothness and file size for your specific use case.
• 📤 Flexible Input Options
Upload videos directly from your device or provide a video URL for quick processing without downloading.
• ⚡ Fast Processing 
AI-powered enhancement engine delivers high-quality results efficiently, with clear cost visibility before processing.
• 👁️ Real-Time Preview
Review your source video before enhancement to ensure you're working with the right content.
• 🔄 Easy Reset
Quickly reset all settings to default values and start fresh with different parameters.
👥 Who It's For
• Content Creators: upgrade older footage and phone videos to professional quality for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram
• Marketing Teams: enhance promotional videos, product demos, and testimonials for better audience engagement
• E-commerce Sellers: improve product video quality to increase customer confidence and conversions
• Social Media Managers: optimize video content for different platforms with appropriate resolution settings
• Educators: enhance recorded lessons, webinars, and training videos for clearer viewing
• Personal Projects: restore and improve home videos, travel footage, and cherished memories
🚀 Getting Started
1. Click Upload Video or Video URL
 Choose Upscale (720p / 1080p / 4K) and set Frame Rate
 Click Generate Video and review the Preview
 Click Download to save your enhanced video
💡 Best Practices
• Start with the best source possible: Higher quality input videos produce better enhancement results
• Choose resolution wisely: Select 1080p for most uses; reserve 4K for projects requiring maximum detail
• Match frame rate to content type: 30 FPS works well for most content; use 60 FPS for sports or action footage
• Preview before processing: Always check your uploaded video to confirm it's the correct file
⚙️ Technical Details
• Supported Input Methods: Direct file upload or video URL
• Output Resolutions: 720p, 1080p, 4K
• Frame Rate Range: Adjustable via slider (standard range covers most common needs)
• Processing Time: Varies based on video length and selected resolution
• Credit System: Transparent cost display before generation
🔐 Privacy & Security
We respect your privacy. Your prompts and uploads are processed only to generate videos. Projects are saved to your account per your settings and can be deleted anytime. See our website privacy policy for details.
📚 Support & Resources
If you have questions or need help, contact support with details and screenshots for faster assistance.

firefox-addons:2779698.summary: Password sharing done secure, simple, and covert.
firefox-addons:2779698.description:

firefox-addons:777.name: New Tab Homepage
firefox-addons:777.summary: A very simple tabbed browsing extension that loads your homepage when you open a new tab. If you have multiple homepages, the first is chosen.
firefox-addons:777.description:
Firefox 57+ users 
Please note, I am aware of the problem of the cursor being placed in the location / URL bar, at the start of the URL. I have filed bug 1411465 for this issue, which needs a Firefox / API fix. Unless anyone has any bright ideas, it seems I can't do much about this from the add-on right now.

A very simple tabbed browsing extension that loads your homepage when you open a new tab. If you have multiple homepages, the first is chosen.

If you're using one of those, you do not need this extension and it most likely will not work even if you install it! In this case, you should use the in-built options in whichever tabbed browsing extension that you use.

apple-macos:6798971615.description:
Photo FaceFinder — Your Photos, Perfectly Organized by Face
AI-powered face recognition that groups, finds, and organizes every person in your photo library — automatically.
Stop scrolling through thousands of photos to find the ones with someone you care about. Photo FaceFinder scans your entire library, detects every face, and groups your photos by person — so you can jump straight to every picture of your kid, your best friend, or any family member in seconds.
100% Offline. 100% Private.
All face detection and matching happens locally on your device — no cloud uploads, no accounts required to scan, no one but you ever sees your library. Your photos are never sent anywhere, analyzed by a third party, or used to train anything. What's on your device stays on your device.
Works With External & Removable Drives
Got years of photos on a USB stick or external hard drive? Photo FaceFinder scans removable storage directly, so you can organize archives that never touch the cloud or even your device's internal storage. Perfect for old family archives, inherited hard drives, or photo backups you've been meaning to sort for years.
HOW IT WORKS
Point Photo FaceFinder at a folder, drive, or your full photo library
The app scans every image and detects the faces in it
Matching faces are automatically grouped into people — no tagging required
Tap any person to instantly see every photo they appear in
KEY FEATURES
AI Face Recognition — automatic, accurate face detection with no manual tagging
Person Grouping — every photo of the same person, organized into one place
Family Photo Finder — quickly pull up every photo of a specific family member
Similar Face Search — find lookalike faces and related photos across your library
Duplicate Detection — spot and clear out repeated or near-identical shots
Full offline processing — your library never leaves your device
Scan external drives, USB storage, and removable media
Clean, simple interface — point it at your photos and go
WHO IT'S FOR
Parents with years of photos of their kids scattered across devices and drives
Anyone digitizing and sorting an old family photo archive
Photographers and hobbyists managing large personal libraries
Anyone who wants their photos organized without handing them to the cloud
PRIVACY YOU CAN VERIFY
We built Photo FaceFinder around a simple rule: your photos are yours. There's no server-side processing, no background uploads, and no hidden data collection. Face matching runs entirely through on-device machine learning, so your library — and the people in it — never leave your control.
FREE TO START
Scan your library and start grouping photos by face at no cost. Unlock Photo FaceFinder+ for unlimited scanning, faster batch processing on large libraries, priority support, and advanced organization tools like custom albums and export options.
Your memories, finally organized the way you actually look for them — by face, not by folder. Download Photo FaceFinder today and rediscover the photos that matter most.
Compatible with iOS 16 or later.
Terms of Use: https://www.photofacefinder.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.photofacefinder.com/privacy
**Support:** https://www.photofacefinder.com/

RSS Bot is your perfect companion to keep up to date with all of your RSS feeds in a simple, sleek and friendly manner. 
All the information to keep you updated is available at your fingertips through this brilliant FREE app.
RSS Bot lets you:
- Check RSS feeds straight from your menubar
- Get Mountain Lion notifications for new rss items
- Filter RSS feed items, so only articles that match your keywords are shown
- Set the app to start at login
- Change notification sounds
- Open with Readability
- Choose to set a time for automatically marking feeds as 'Read'
- macOS Dark Mode support
Note: After adding a new RSS feed, you wil begin to receive notifications for RSS items (news articles) that are posted after the date and time you added the feed. RSS Bot will not notify you of old news items (i.e. those posted on the RSS that are dated prior to the date/time you added the feed to the app).
We've spent a lot of time thinking about the details and fine tuning RSS Bot, in order to make it your perfect RSS feed reader app. We're sure that within a few days, you will begin to love our little creative touches. We plan on a very active development cycle, so please spread the word and send us any feedback you may have!
